title: Low-Calorie Korean Sujebi
description: A traditional Korean dish made with low-calorie noodles and sujebi, perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Low-calorie noodles
ingredients.notes: Choose a brand with minimal added sugars and salt

ingredients.name: Sujebi
ingredients.notes: Traditional Korean noodle soup made with anchovy broth

ingredients.name: Low-sodium broth
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade broth

instructions: Bring the broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the sliced ginger and garlic.
Cook for 2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the low-calorie noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Add the sujebi and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with black pepper.
